title: Which clients cover which parts of the Cloud Connector API: Python v1 and v2, Go, Terraform

prose.text: Cloud & Branch Connector is automated through the Python SDK's `ztw` package, the Go SDK's `ztw` services and the ZTC Terraform provider. Each one's modules, functions and resources are generated; this subject records the coverage differences an agent needs when choosing between them.

prose.label: Workload groups.
prose.text: No client writes workload groups: the Go SDK's writes are commented out, [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.coverage:workload-groups-writes-commented]], the Python module only lists them, [[cloud-connector.sdk-python.coverage:workload-groups-list-only]], and the provider has only a data source, [[cloud-connector.terraform.forwarding-rules:no-workload-group-resource]].

prose.label: Go gaps.
prose.text: The Go SDK's commented-out activation CLI and other functions it leaves out are in [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.coverage:activation-cli-commented]] and [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.coverage]].

checks.do: Whether a Python project that automates Cloud Connector is pinned to the v1.x line, since the v2.x beta does not include ZTW.

python-v2-excludes-ztw.statement: The Python SDK's v2.x beta (`2.0.0bN`), announced in release 1.9.23, covers ZIA, ZDX and ZIdentity only; ZPA, ZCC, ZTW, ZTB and ZWA remain on v1.x, which stays the recommended GA release.

quotes: is now available as a pre-release (`2.0.0bN`) on PyPI.
**Limited product coverage in the beta:** ZIA, ZDX, ZIdentity. ZPA, ZCC, ZTW, ZTB, and ZWA remain on v1.x for now.
**v1.x remains the recommended GA release** and continues to receive bug fixes and security patches.

ip-pools-are-ip-groups.statement: The `/ipGroups` endpoints manage IP pools, which the ZTC provider exposes as `ztc_ip_pool_groups` through the Go SDK's `policyresources/ipgroups` package.

quotes: - Added `GET /ipGroups` Retrieves the list of IP pools.
- Added `POST /ipGroups` Adds a new custom IP pool.

python-ip-groups-partial.statement: The Python SDK's `ip_groups` module lists, creates and deletes IP pools but has no get-by-ID or update method: its methods are `list_ip_groups`, `list_ip_groups_lite`, `add_ip_group` and `delete_ip_group`.
python-ip-groups-partial.conditions: The five def lines quoted are every method the module defines at the pin.
